payout_value_note: Flat $50 cash to the referrer per referred loan closed (loan minimum $5,000). No cap stated.
payout_quote: Refer your friends and family to take advantage of our low loan rates and you'll receive $50 cash! ... when they close a loan* with us, we'll deposit $50 into your account.
steps: Have the friend or family member mention your name when they apply for their loan (referral cards optional).
The person must qualify for the loan; loan minimum of $5,000 to qualify for the referral reward.
Existing borrowers and members are not eligible to be referred.
$50 cash deposited to the referrer's account after 30 days of the loan closing.
catches: Loan minimum of $5,000 — small loans don't qualify.
Existing SWOFCU borrowers and members are NOT eligible to be referred.
All parties must be 18+; accounts in good standing.
Cash deposited after 30 days of loan closing.
SWOFCU may withdraw the offer at any time; value may be subject to income-tax reporting.
biggest_catch: The referred person must close a loan of at least $5,000 — and existing members/borrowers are excluded, so this is a genuinely hard referral.
eligibility: SWOFCU members; referred person must qualify for the loan.
timing: Referral handoff ~5 min active; $50 deposited after 30 days of loan closing.
